package student

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type practiceEvidenceRepositoryStub struct {
	accepted bool
	calls    int
	evidence domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle
}

func (stub *practiceEvidenceRepositoryStub) ApplyPracticeEvidence(_ context.Context, evidence domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle) (bool, error) {
	stub.calls++
	stub.evidence = evidence
	return stub.accepted, nil
}

func TestApplyPracticeEvidenceNormalizesAndReturnsIdempotentReceipt(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	evidenceID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	repository := &practiceEvidenceRepositoryStub{accepted: false}
	useCase := ApplyPracticeEvidence{Evidence: repository}
	receipt, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), studentID, evidenceID, domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundle{
		Schema: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV1, EvidenceID: evidenceID,
		StudentID: studentID, TaskInstanceID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		TaskRevisionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", SubmissionID: evidenceID,
		Outcome: "passed", AssistancePolicyVersion: "practice-assistance-v1",
		Evidence: []domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidence{{
			Target:      domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap", Version: "v1"},
			Correctness: 1, Independence: 1, Confidence: 0.9, StepIDs: []string{"implement"},
		}},
		OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 2, 1, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), PolicyVersion: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV1,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if receipt.Accepted || receipt.EvidenceID != evidenceID || repository.calls != 1 || repository.evidence.RequestHash == "" {
		t.Fatalf("receipt=%+v calls=%d evidence=%+v", receipt, repository.calls, repository.evidence)
	}
}
